title: Lifting reverse-degree components without differential equations
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and P a cochain complex of O_Y-modules [def-pc-derived-category], supported in [0,d] for d in N, with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Fix y in V, where V is an open of Y. Write PV=P restricted to V and T for termwise pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem(y). Let h(i,j):T(PV)^i -> T(PV)^j be any family which is zero unless i=j+1. No differential equation is assumed. There exist an open U<=V containing y, a natural isomorphism e:R followed by S ~= T on all cochain complexes of O_V-modules, and a family k(i,j):(R(PV))^i -> (R(PV))^j zero unless i=j+1, such that S(k(i,j))=e(PV).hom^i ; h(i,j) ; e(PV).inv^j for every i,j. Here R is restriction along Y.homOfLE(U<=V), and S is termwise pullback along U.fromSpecStalkOfMem(y).

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs: local unit-entry cancellation and extension of the finite calculation; finite matrix homotopy identities after shrinking

proof.text: Restrict each chosen finite free presentation of P.X n to V using restrictFreeIso. Index the relevant ordered pairs by the product of the finite integer interval [0,d] with itself. Conjugate the prescribed component h(i,j) by the pullbacks of the chosen bases to obtain a finite family of maps between standard free sheaves. Apply the finite-matrix lifting theorem to obtain U inside V, the prescribed natural module comparison e0, and the lifted standard-free maps.

Transport each lifted standard-free map back through the restricted bases. Naturality of e0.hom and e0.inv, followed by cancellation of the mapped basis isomorphisms, proves its stalk image equals e0(PV.X i).hom composed with h(i,j) composed with e0(PV.X j).inv. This is the fully proved private transport_lift helper. Apply Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso to e0, obtaining the natural isomorphism e on every complex on V.

Define k(i,j) by these lifted maps when i and j lie in [0,d] and the reverse-degree relation holds; define it as zero otherwise. This gives its required support directly. For a pair in the finite range with reverse-degree relation, use the transported component equation. If the relation fails, use hzero. If either degree is outside [0,d], strict boundedness makes the original term a zero object; restriction and pullback preserve zero objects, so h(i,j)=0. Map preservation of zero and zero-composition identities finish these cases. The termwise components of the natural complex comparison are the components of e0, so all equations have the required type.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_lift_reverse_components
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (h : ∀ i j : ℤ,
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P)).X i ⟶
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P)).X j)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, ¬ (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel j i → h i j = 0) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hyU : y ∈ U),
      let R := (restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hUV)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      let S := (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      let T := (Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      let PV := ((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P
      ∃ (e : R ⋙ S ≅ T) (k : ∀ i j : ℤ, (R.obj PV).X i ⟶ (R.obj PV).X j),
        (∀ i j, ¬ (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel j i → k i j = 0) ∧
        ∀ i j, (Modules.pullback (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyU)).map (k i j) =
          (e.app PV).hom.f i ≫ h i j ≫ (e.app PV).inv.f j
